intent: Hold arbitrary content at the foot of the placeholder, such as a search field or a short form, in a centered column.
typical_uses: A field or small form that lets the user fill the empty state from where it is shown

dont_use_when.situation: The foot holds only a row of buttons

invariants.text: EmptyContent is a flex column capped at 24rem that centers its children, so a lone button keeps its own width instead of stretching, and spaces them var(--space-4) apart.

good.title: A search field at the foot of the placeholder

bad.title: Two buttons stacked by EmptyContent
bad.why: EmptyContent is a column, so the buttons stack one above the other; EmptyActions is the part that sets them side by side.
